blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pre-trained encoders fine-tuned on natural language inference (NLI) and other language understanding tasks keep much of their accuracy after the input is perturbed, e.g. by removing all nouns or shuffling the words. Does the same hold for large language models (LLMs), and if so, is it because they have seen the benchmarks during pre-training? In this paper we revisit these perturbation experiments with eight LLMs alongside fine-tuned encoders on GLUE and the three rounds of ANLI. Regardless of model size, every system that answers directly retains 36-72% of its above-chance performance without nouns on MNLI compared to only 14-29% on ANLI. Only a model that reasons before answering departs from this pattern. We also check contamination indicators (including exact $n$-gram counts in the public pre-training data of two of the models) and find no link between exposure and robustness. Our strongest evidence comes from 368 new, human-validated items that none of the models can have seen. All eight LLMs keep more of their performance without nouns on items written in MNLI's style than on items written without its cues. When the perturbation instead removes the function words carrying such cues, this advantage reverses. In light of these results, we argue that robustness to perturbation on familiar NLI benchmarks reflects dataset shortcuts rather than memorisation, and tells us more about the benchmark than about the model.
blocks.zh: 对自然语言推论(NLI)和其他语言理解任务进行精细化的预训编码器在输入被扰动后保留了大部分精度,如删除所有名词或打乱词. 大型语言模型(LLMs)是否同样适用,如果适用,是否因为他们在培训前就已经看到基准? 在本文中,我们用8个LLMs与GLUE和三轮ANLI上的微调编码器一起,重新审视这些扰动实验. 不论型号大小,每个直接回答的系统都保留了36-72%的超强性能,在MNLI上没有名词,而ANLI上只有14-29%. 只有一种在回答前说明理由的模式偏离了这种模式。 我们还检查污染指标(包括两个模型的公共培训前数据中准确的美元计数),发现接触与稳健之间没有任何联系。 我们最有力的证据来自368件新的,人类验证的物品,这些模型都看不到. 所有8个LLMs都保留着更多没有MNLI风格所写项目的名词的性能,而不是没有它的提示所写项目. 当扰动代替去掉带有这种提示的函数单词时,这个优势就会反转. 鉴于这些结果,我们认为,强力干扰熟悉的NLI基准反映了数据集快捷方式,而不是记忆,并告诉我们更多的基准而不是模型。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Benchmark performance remains the primary evidence supporting claims regarding the language understanding capabilities of current models.
However, achieving high scores on benchmarks does not mean that the model solves the problem as intended by the benchmark.
One method to verify this is to transform the input data by removing information that humans need, and then check if the model still makes accurate predictions.
While previous studies referred to this as data corruption, we use word-class ablation for word removal and word-order perturbation for changing word order. Talman et al. (2021) and Talman et al. (2022) performed this type of evaluation on fine-tuned encoders.
Accuracy was largely maintained on MNLI and various GLUE tasks even when nouns, verbs, or other parts of speech were all removed or when the word order was shuffled. This was the case even though human readers found many of the resulting items difficult or impossible to label.
blocks.zh:
基准业绩仍然是关于现有模型语言理解能力索赔的主要证据。
然而,在基准上取得高分并不意味着该模型能够按照基准的设想解决问题。
一种验证的方法是通过去除人类需要的信息来转换输入数据,然后检查模型是否仍然作出准确的预测.
虽然先前的研究将这称为数据腐败,但我们使用词类去除和词序扰动来改变词序. 塔尔曼等 (2021)和塔尔曼等. (2022)在微调编码器上进行了这种评价.
在MNLI和各种GLUE任务上基本保持了准确性,即使名词,动词,或语音的其他部分全部被去掉或者单词顺序被打乱. 虽然人类读者发现许多由此产生的物品很难或不可能贴上标签,但情况还是如此。

blocks.en:
For large language models (LLMs), the same questions are raised again in different settings.
LLMs are pre-trained on web-scale corpora that may already contain benchmark items, and are increasingly being evaluated without task-specific fine-tuning.
If an LLM maintains accuracy on perturbed MNLI items, two explanations are possible.
The first is memorisation: the model recognises the item even after perturbation because it encountered it during pre-training.
The second is that the item can be solved from superficial cues that remain after perturbation, such as negation words in the hypothesis (shortcuts or annotation artefacts).
These two explanations lead to different empirical predictions.
According to the memorisation account, items present in the pre-training corpus should be more robust than absent items, and the effect should be greatest on the benchmarks with the highest potential for leakage. Conversely, if robustness stems from shortcuts, items that a model can solve solely from the hypothesis should be more robust regardless of prior exposure, and this advantage should disappear if the cue-providing words themselves are removed.
blocks.zh:
对于大型语言模型(LLMs),不同的设置中再次提出同样的问题.
有限责任公司在网络规模公司进行预先培训,这些公司可能已经包含基准项目,并且越来越多地在没有具体任务调整的情况下进行评估。
如果LLM在扰动的MNLI项目上保持精度,可以有两种解释.
第一个是纪念:模型甚至在扰动后也承认该物品,因为它在训练前遇到过。
第二是,从扰动后留下的表面提示,如假设中的否定语(短语或注解工艺品),可以解决该项目.
这两种解释导致了不同的经验预测.
根据 " 记忆 " 的说法,培训前文书中的物品应比没有的物品更坚固,对最有可能漏出的基准的影响应最大。 反之,如果强健性来自快捷方式,则一个模型仅能从假设中解决的项目,无论是否事先暴露,都应当更强健,而如果提示提供词本身被去掉,这种优势就应当消失.

blocks.en:
This paper tests both of these predictions.
First, we reproduce previously published encoder results on the MNLI dataset within 1 percentage point, and then re-examine the perturbation experiments of Talman et al. (2021) ; Talman et al. (2022) using four open-weight LLMs, four hosted LLMs, and fine-tuned encoders.
The main contributions of this paper are as follows: • We demonstrate that the gap between MNLI and ANLI lies in the dataset, not the model. Regardless of model size, all systems that answer directly keep much more of their performance on MNLI than on ANLI when nouns are removed (36–72% vs. 14–29%). Only the model that reasons before answering deviates from this pattern. • Introducing perturbations to the inputs causes the LLMs to be biased toward a single label, so that raw accuracy can underestimate how much performance is retained, and we measure robustness after correcting for these biases. • We find no association between the three contamination indicators and robustness. Rather, in all three of the most robust LLMs on MNLI, items solvable solely from the hypothesis are more robust, and this advantage is reversed when function words are removed. • We construct 368 new, human-validated NLI items written either in the MNLI style or without cues. All eight LLMs exhibit the same shortcut pattern in these unseen items. • We compare MNLI with BioASQ, a benchmark without hypothesis cues. BioASQ is also robust to perturbation, but for a different reason: many of its questions can be answered directly from biomedical knowledge. In other words, robustness against perturbation alone cannot prove language understanding or memorisation.
What it reveals depends on which cues remain intact even after perturbation is applied.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Several studies have shown that models fine-tuned on NLI and other GLUE tasks are remarkably insensitive to changes in input form. Sinha et al. (2021b) show that NLI models predict the same label across many permutations of a sentence pair, while Pham et al. (2021) and Gupta et al. (2021) report comparable findings for word order on GLUE.
Even at the pre-training stage, Sinha et al. (2021a) find that training on shuffled text causes very little degradation on downstream tasks.
For word removal, Talman et al. (2021) ablate entire word classes in MNLI and ANLI and find that models trained on the ablated data still reach high accuracy. Talman et al. (2022) extend these experiments across GLUE and show that the outcome varies considerably by task.
Removing nouns and verbs has the largest impact, whereas some tasks barely change at all.
Nearly all of this work, however, predates instruction-tuned LLMs, which are normally evaluated without task-specific training.
blocks.zh:
一些研究显示,对NLI和其他GLUE任务进行微调的模型对输入形式的变化非常不敏感。 Sinha等 (2021b) 显示NLI模型在一对句子的多处外观上预测出相同的标签,而Pham等 (2021)和Gupta等 (2021) 则报告在GLUE上可比较的词序结果.
即使在培训前阶段,Sinha等人(2021a)也发现被洗发的文字培训对下游任务几乎没有造成什么退化.
关于去字,Talman等人(2021年)在MNLI和ANLI中将整个去字分数分解,并发现在去字分解数据方面受过训练的模型仍然达到高精度. Talman等人(2022年)将这些实验扩展至GLUE,并显示结果因任务而有很大差异.
删除名词和动词的影响最大,而有些任务几乎没有改变.
然而,几乎所有这项工作都早于指导性课程调整,通常在没有具体任务培训的情况下对其进行评估。

blocks.en:
Crowdsourced NLI corpora are known to contain annotation artefacts that allow a classifier to predict the label without looking at the premise. Gururangan et al. (2018) and Poliak et al. (2018) demonstrate that hypothesis-only models perform well above chance on both SNLI and MNLI, with negation and other function words serving as strong indicators of contradiction.
In addition, McCoy et al. (2019) show that NLI models rely heavily on lexical overlap heuristics.
ANLI ( Nie et al., 2020 ) was constructed adversarially to address this issue, asking annotators to write hypotheses that fool strong models and thereby reducing the scope for such cues.
blocks.zh:
据了解,Crowdsourced NLI corpora中含有注释文物,允许分类者在不查看前提的情况下预测标签. Gurururangan等人(2018年)和Poliak等人(2018年)表明,仅假设模型在SNLI和MNLI上的表现都远远高于机会,否定词和其他函数词是强烈的矛盾指标.
此外,McCoy等人(2019年)也表明NLI模型严重依赖词典重叠的heuristics.
ANLI(Nie等,2020年)是针对这一问题而构建的,它要求注释者写出那些愚弄强健模型的假说,从而缩小这种暗示的范围.

blocks.en:
As pre-training corpora grow in scale, evaluation benchmarks are increasingly likely to be included in them ( Sainz et al., 2023 ) .
Where the pre-training data are accessible, benchmark overlap can be measured directly, e.g. through exact n n -gram counts ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
When the training data are not open, contamination has to be probed indirectly through model behaviour.
Existing approaches either ask the model to complete or fill in parts of benchmark items ( Golchin and Surdeanu, 2024 ; Deng et al., 2024 ) , or inspect the likelihood assigned to an item’s least probable tokens ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
随着培训前公司规模的扩大,评价基准越来越有可能被纳入其中(Sainz等人,2023年)。
在可获取培训前数据的地方,可直接衡量基准重叠,例如通过准确的n-克计数(Liu等人,2024年)。
在培训数据不开放时,必须通过模型行为间接地探测出污染。
现有办法或要求模型完成或填写部分基准项目(Golchin and Surdeanu, 2024; Deng等人, 2024;),或检查分配给物品最不可行的标志的可能性(Shi等人, 2024;Zhang等人, 2025)。

blocks.en: When LLMs are prompted to output a class label, they often favour particular answers regardless of the input, although recentring the answer scores removes this preference ( Zhao et al., 2021 ; Holtzman et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 当LLMs被激励输出一个类标签时,无论输入多少,他们往往偏爱特定答案,尽管最近解答分数消除了这种偏好(Zhao等,2021;Holtzman等,2021).

blocks.en: Our work connects these threads: on a shared set of models and items, we test whether robustness under perturbation follows pre-training contamination or dataset shortcuts, and we pull the two apart using newly written items that none of the models can have seen.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作连接了这些线程:在一组共享的模型和项目上,我们测试在扰动下的稳健性是否遵循了训练前的污染或者数据集的快捷方式,我们用新写的项目来拉开这两条线程,这些模型都看不到.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Set-up
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Perturbations
blocks.zh: 3.1 骚扰

blocks.en:
We use the perturbations of Talman et al. (2022) , applied independently to each text field of an item, and keep the earlier condition names ( Corrupt-Train , Corrupt-Test ).
Words are tagged with the universal part-of-speech tagset ( Petrov et al., 2012 ) using NLTK ( Bird et al., 2009 ) . drop-X removes all words of class X (e.g. drop-NOUN ); keep-X+Y keeps only words of the listed classes (e.g. keep-NOUN+VERB , which removes all function words); shuffle-n k k splits each field into consecutive k k -grams and shuffles their order ( Pham et al., 2021 ) ; hyp-only removes the premise.
Perturbed text is detokenised and fields that become empty are kept, as in Talman et al. (2022) ; for the reproduction of Talman et al. (2021) we use that paper’s conventions and, where available, its released files.
In total there are 19 perturbations; for the hosted models we use a core set of ten. 1 1 1 clean , drop-NOUN , drop-VERB , drop-ADJ , drop-DET , drop-PRON , shuffle-n1 , shuffle-n3 , keep-NOUN+VERB , hyp-only .

blocks.en: 3.2 Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据

blocks.en:
We evaluate on the development sets of the GLUE tasks ( Wang et al., 2018 ) , using the matched development set for MNLI ( Williams et al., 2018 ) , and on the test sets of the three ANLI rounds ( Nie et al., 2020 ) .
The original splits and metrics are kept: accuracy for MNLI, QNLI, RTE, SST-2 and ANLI, F1 for MRPC and QQP, Matthews correlation for CoLA and Pearson correlation for STS-B.
For the hosted models, for five-shot prompting and for the contamination checks we use a fixed label-stratified sample of 2,000 items for MNLI and QQP.
blocks.zh:
我们评价GLUE任务的开发集(Wang等,2018年),使用MNLI的匹配开发集(Williams等,2018年),以及三发ANLI的测试集(Nie等,2020年).
原分数和度量衡保持:MNLI,QNLI,RTE,SST-2和ANLI的精度,MRPC和QQP的F1,CoLA的Matthews相关和STS-B的Pearson相关.
对于主机型号,用于五发提示和污染检查,我们使用一个固定的标注样本,为MNLI和QQP提供2 000件物品。

blocks.en:
As a control that no model can have seen, we built 368 new NLI items (Appendix E ).
Premises are sentences from Wikipedia articles created, and from Wikipedia’s daily current-events pages written, after 1 September 2026, excluding any sentence with a 13-gram found in OLMo’s pre-training data.
Two models that we do not evaluate, Llama 4 Maverick and GPT-5.5, wrote one hypothesis per label for each premise, in two styles: following MNLI’s annotation instructions with MNLI training pairs as examples ( MNLI style ), and with instructions that rule out the best-known hypothesis-only cues such as negation in contradictions ( cue-free ).
A further set pairs sentences from the first and the current version of new Wikipedia articles.
Fourteen volunteers labelled the items without seeing the intended label; we keep items whose labels all agree with the intended one and that nobody flagged, giving 168 MNLI-style, 148 cue-free and 52 naturally occurring pairs.

14名志愿者在未看到预定标签的情况下标出这些物品;我们保留其标签都与预定标签一致且无人标出的物品,给168个MNLI型、148个无提示型和52个自然出现的对。

blocks.en: 3.3 Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式

blocks.en:
As a reference we fine-tune RoBERTa-base ( Liu et al., 2019 ) , BERT-base ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , ModernBERT-base ( Warner et al., 2025 ) and XLM-R-base ( Conneau et al., 2020 ) on clean training data (3 epochs, batch size 32, learning rate 2 ⋅ 10 − 5 2\cdot 10^{-5} , three seeds).
Ablated training data ( Corrupt-Train ) is used only for the reproduction.
For ANLI we use the released RoBERTa-large model of Nie et al. (2020) , trained on SNLI, MNLI, FEVER-NLI and ANLI.
blocks.zh:
作为参考,我们对RoBERTa-base(刘等,2019年),BERT-base(Devlin等,2019年),ModernBERT-base(Warner等,2025年)和XLM-R-base(Conneau等,2020年)的清洁训练数据进行了精细调整(3个纪元,分批大小32个,学习率2−×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××,3个种子).
延迟培训数据(Corrupt-Train)仅用于复制.
对于ANLI,我们使用发行的"Nie等"(2020年)的"RoBERTa"大模型,经过了SNLI,MNLI,FEVER-NLI和ANLI的训练.

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.8-27B, Muse Glimmer 30B and the base versions of OLMo 3 7B and 32B, whose pre-training data are public. 2 2 2 Hugging Face checkpoints Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B , meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B , allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B and allenai/Olmo-3-1125-32B . Each item is formatted with a task instruction that ends in a one-word answer choice (e.g. Answer with one word: entailment, neutral, or contradiction. ), with the model’s chat template where it has one and reasoning switched off.
The prediction is the answer word with the highest log-probability.
In the five-shot setting the prompt contains five training examples, either clean or with nouns removed ( drop-NOUN ), the in-context analogue of Corrupt-Train .

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Before moving on to LLMs, we verify that our pipeline reproduces the previous encoder results (Appendix A ). On MNLI, all 8 reproduced scores for RoBERTa-base and BERT-base are within 0.6 points of the published ones, the other GLUE tasks are within about 3 points with two explained exceptions, and the public ANLI model of Nie et al. (2020) is within 3 points on all three rounds, clean and perturbed.
blocks.zh: 在进入LLMS之前,我们验证我们的管道复制了之前的编码器结果(附录A.). 在MNLI上,RoBERTa-base和BERT-base的8个再生分数均在已公布分数的0.6分以内,其他GLUE任务在3分以内,有2个解释的例外,而Nie等人(2020年)的公开ANLI模型在所有三发中均在3分以内,干净而扰动.

blocks.en: 4.1 Perturbation Effects Across Systems
blocks.zh: 4.1 跨系统干扰效应

blocks.en: Table 1 and Figure 1 summarise how much performance the systems maintain. An LLM not trained on the task at all is expected to behave differently from a fine-tuned encoder. In some respects, that is the case. Excluding nouns, open-weight LLMs maintain slightly lower MNLI performance than RoBERTa (47–70% vs. 72%), but maintain higher RTE performance (29–40% vs. 19%).
blocks.zh: 表1和图1概述了这些系统保持的绩效。 完全没有受过任务培训的LLM,预期其行为与微调编码器不同. 在某些方面,情况就是这样。 不包括名词,开放量级LLMS保持略低于RoBERTA(47-70%对72%)的MNLI性能,但保持较高的RTE性能(29-40%对19%).

blocks.en: However, the more notable result is what the systems share in common. Excluding nouns, open-weight LLMs retain 47–70% of their above-chance performance on MNLI, whereas on ANLI they retain only 14–29% (averaged over the three rounds). RoBERTa shows the same contrast (72% vs. 24%), and similar results are observed in the hosted models GPT-4o (56% vs. 26%), DeepSeek-V4-Pro (49% vs. 25%), and Mistral Large 3 (36% vs. 23%), which is scored on raw answers. When word order is shuffled, the performance difference becomes even more pronounced. Open-weight LLMs maintain 32–52% on MNLI and up to 27% on ANLI rounds, whereas OLMo 3 is close to or below chance on ANLI R1 and R2 (Figure 1 ). Among the GLUE tasks, CoLA, where labels are determined by word order and morphology, is most affected, whereas SST-2 maintains most of its performance, similar to Talman et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 然而,更为显著的结果是这些系统的共同之处。 除名词外,开放重量级有限责任公司保留了MNLI的47-70%以上业绩,而ANLI则只保留了14-29%(在三轮比赛中平均)。 RoBERTA显示的对比度相同(72%对24%),在主机型GPT-4o(56%对26%),DeepSeek-V4-Pro(49%对25%)和Mistral Large 3(36%对23%)中也观察到类似的结果,后者在原始答案上得分. 当文字顺序被打乱后,性能差异会变得更加明显. 开放重量级的LLMs在 MNLI 上维持32-52%,在 ANLI 上维持高达27%,而OLMo 3则在 ANLI R1 和 R2 上接近或低于机会(图1)。 在GLUE任务中,由词序和形态决定标签的CoLA受影响最大,而SST-2则保持了大部分性能,与Talman等(2022)相类似.

blocks.en: Model size does not substantially affect robustness. OLMo 3 7B and 32B were trained on the same data, and the larger model shows 10 points higher performance on clean ANLI. However, both models maintain similar retention on MNLI without nouns (68% and 70%), while the larger model shows only slightly higher retention on ANLI (19% vs. 14%). Unlike training an encoder on ablated data, five ablated in-context examples also do not help (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 模型规模不会对稳健性产生重大影响。 OLMo 3 7B和32B接受了同样的数据培训,更大的模型显示在干净的ANLI上10分更高的性能. 然而,两种模型在无名词的MNLI上都保持了相类似的保留(68%和70%),而较大的模型在ANLI上只显示保留略高(19%对14%). 与在被启示的数据上训练编码器不同,五个被启示的被启示的被启示文本中的例子也无济于事(Appendix C.

blocks.en: 4.2 Perturbed Input Shifts the Answer Distribution
blocks.zh: 4.2 扰动输入移动答题分布

blocks.en: Perturbed input not only removes information but also biases LLMs toward a single answer. Table 6 in Appendix D shows the proportion of items receiving the most frequent answer. When nouns are removed, Muse Glimmer 30B provides the same answer for 96–99% of MNLI, ANLI R1, and RTE items, and Qwen3.8-27B for 90% of RTE items, compared to 51–64% with clean input. Therefore, part of the decrease in accuracy is due to changes in the decision threshold rather than information loss.
blocks.zh: 干扰性输入不仅消除信息,而且偏向于单一答案。 附录D的表6显示最经常得到答复的项目的比例。 在去除名词时,Muse Glimmer 30B为96-99%的MNLI,ANLI R1和RTE项目提供了相同的答案,而Qune3.8-27B为90%的RTE项目提供了相同的答案,相比之下,51-64%的RTE项目提供了干净的输入. 因此,准确性下降的部分原因是决定门槛的变化,而不是信息损失。

blocks.en: Recentring the answer scores recovers up to 10 points (Qwen3.8-27B on RTE), and threshold-independent AUC shows the same results. The OLMo 3 models are less affected, and the three measures show agreement within approximately 2 points in ANLI R1 and RTE. For three of the four models, the ranking of tasks is the same under all three measures, with the least loss on MNLI and the greatest on ANLI R1 and RTE; the exception is Muse Glimmer 30B, whose raw MNLI accuracy is already low on clean input because of its answer bias.
blocks.zh: 近期解答分数恢复到10分(RTE上的Quen3.8-27B),而阈值独立的AUC显示的结果相同. OLMo 3模型受影响较小,在ANLI R1和RTE中,这三项措施在约2分范围内表现出一致. 对于四个模型中的三个,任务排序在所有三个度量下都是相同的,MNLI的损失最小,而ANLI R1和RTE的损失最大;例外的是Muse Glimmer 30B,由于它的答案偏差,其原始MNLI精度已经低了.

blocks.en: 4.3 Hosted Models
blocks.zh: 4.3 东道模式

blocks.en:
GPT-4o, scored by centred accuracy from its answer-token log-probabilities, behaves like the open-weight LLMs (Table 1 ), answer bias included: without nouns, the share of MNLI items receiving the most frequent answer rises from 38% to 65%, and recentring reduces the accuracy drop from 28.2 to 20.9 points.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro shows the strongest answer bias of all systems. Without nouns, it gives the same answer for 87% of MNLI items and 93% of RTE items, compared to 52% and 59% with clean input.
Judged by raw accuracy alone, it would keep only 22% of its above-chance MNLI performance, which is misleading: centred accuracy gives 49%.
blocks.zh:
GPT-4o从它的答对逻辑概率中以中心精度得分,表现得像开量LLMs(表1),答对偏差包括:没有名词,MNLI项目获得最常答对的比例从38%升至65%,而近代环将精度从28.2分降至20.9分.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro显示了所有系统最强的答案偏差. 没有名词,它对87%的MNLI项目和93%的RTE项目给出了同样的答案,相比之下,52%和59%的RTE项目有干净的投入.
仅以原始准确性来判断,它只保留了上面的MNLI性能的22%,这是误导性的:中心准确性给出了49%.

blocks.en:
Grok 4.7, which reasons before answering, is the only system that does not follow the pattern.
It does better on clean ANLI than on clean MNLI (77.9% vs. 71.8%), and without nouns it keeps about as much of its performance on ANLI as on MNLI (38% vs. 43%), whereas every other system keeps at least twice as much on MNLI.
Since Grok 4.7 returns no answer scores, these are raw accuracies of a single model on the first 400 items of each task, and they should be read with caution.
blocks.zh:
Grok 4.7,答案前的原因,是唯一没有遵循模式的系统.
它在清洁的ANLI上的表现优于清洁的MNLI(77.9%对71.8%),如果没有名词,它在ANLI上的表现就和在MNLI上的表现一样多(38%对43%),而所有其他系统在MNLI上的表现至少是两倍多。
由于Grok 4.7 返回无答分数,这些是每项任务前400项上一个模型的原始快取,应谨慎阅读.

blocks.en: 5 Memorisation or Shortcuts?
blocks.zh: 5 纪念还是捷径?

blocks.en:
Why do all systems keep so much more of their performance on MNLI than on ANLI?
Given that MNLI is old and widely distributed, and thus a likely candidate for pre-training leakage, memorisation is a natural initial hypothesis.
We first test this with three contamination indicators and then examine the alternative, that MNLI entries can be resolved through cues that survive the perturbations.
blocks.zh:
为什么所有的系统 都保持这么多的性能 在MNLI比在ANLI?
鉴于MNLI已经老去并广泛分布,因此很可能是训练前渗出的一个候选者,因此记忆是一种自然的初始假设.
我们首先用三个污染指标测试,然后检查一个替代品, MNLI 条目可以通过在扰动中幸存的提示来解决。

blocks.en: 5.1 Contamination Indicators
blocks.zh: 5.1 污染指标

blocks.en:
Following Deng et al. (2024) , we masked one content word in each entry and asked Qwen3.8-27B to recover it.
In the initial version of this experiment, we allowed the masked word to appear in the other paired sentence, resulting in an exact match rate of 43–70% in the sentence-pair tasks (Table 9 ).
However, most of these matches are obtained simply by copying across the pair.
If masking is restricted to words that do not appear elsewhere within the item, the exact match rate drops to 23–35%, whereas there is no change for the single-sentence tasks CoLA and SST-2.
In these stricter settings, specific benchmarks do not stand out, and ANLI (released in 2020) is recovered with nearly the same frequency as MNLI.
blocks.zh:
继邓等(2024年)后,在每个条目中都掩盖了1个内容词,并请求Quen3.8-27B将其取回.
在这项实验的初始版本中,我们允许蒙面词出现在另一对句子中,结果在句子-pair任务中精确的匹配率为43-70%(表9).
然而,这些匹配大多只是通过复制到对面获得.
如果面具被限制在项目别处出现的单词上,那么精确的匹配率会下降到23–35%,而单发判决任务CoLA和SST-2则没有变化.
在这些更严格的环境下,具体的基准并不突出,ANLI(于2020年发布)的恢复频率与MNLI几乎相同.

blocks.en:
Min-K%++ ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) scores each item using the normalised log probability assigned to the least likely tokens in each item.
For OLMo 3 32B, the highest values appear in ANLI R1 and R2 ( − 1.07 -1.07 and − 1.03 -1.03 ), while for the remaining tasks, they range from − 1.49 -1.49 to − 2.25 -2.25 . In contrast, Qwen3.8-27B does not show a similar pattern.
Since ANLI R1 and R2 are based on Wikipedia passages, these high scores appear to reflect familiarity with the source text rather than exposure to the benchmark itself.
blocks.zh:
Min-KQQ (Zhang等, 2025年) 使用分配给每个项目中最不可能有的符号的常态化日志概率对每个项目进行评分.
对于OLMo 3 32B,最高值出现在ANLI R1和R2(−1.07-1.07和−1.03-1.03)中,而对于所余任务,则从−1.49-1.49到−2.25-2.25不等. 相形之下,Quen3.8-27B没有显示类似的图案.
由于ANLI R1和R2是基于维基百科的段落,这些高分似乎反映了对源文本的熟悉,而不是暴露在基准本身.

blocks.en:
Since OLMo’s pre-training corpus is publicly available, we can also check overlap directly.
Using the infini-gram API ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , we counted two evenly spaced 13-grams of each field (and the entire field, if up to 50 words long) in the OLMo 2 pre-training mix. 4 4 4 Index v4_olmo-mix-1124_llama ; the OLMo 3 index was not yet available, so the counts are a lower bound for OLMo 3. A field counts as found if one of its 13-grams appears, or if the entire field appears and has at least 13 words, since short sentences such as The man is asleep. appear in any large corpus.
The counts support the Min-K%++ reading.
Premises were found in 72% of ANLI R1 entries and 71% of ANLI R2 entries, whereas in MNLI, this figure was only 21%. Conversely, long hypotheses rarely appeared (1–4% for both MNLI and ANLI).
Overall, the OLMo pre-training data contain a large part of the source texts of ANLI, but the benchmark entries themselves appear only rarely.

blocks.en: 5.2 Seen and Unseen Items
blocks.zh: 5.2 已见和未见项目

blocks.en:
If memorisation helps the model process perturbed inputs, items that appeared as text during pre-training should have less performance degradation than unseen items.
For each open-weight LLM, we compared the degradation of items with found premises and of the remaining items on MNLI and the three ANLI rounds, using centred accuracy and five perturbations.
Among all 80 comparisons, 7 have 95% confidence intervals excluding zero, with differences in both directions and an overall average of − 0.8 -0.8 points.
We therefore find no evidence that exposure to the source text increases robustness.
For found hypotheses, the number of items (10–18 per task) is too small to support reliable comparisons of the same type.
blocks.zh:
如果记忆有助于模型处理扰动输入,则在培训前作为文本出现的项目,其性能退化程度应低于未见项目.
对于每个开放重量的LLM,我们利用中心精度和5个扰动,将物品的退化与发现的房舍和MNLI和3发ANLI上的剩余物品作比较。
在所有80个比较中,7个的置信间隔为95%,不包括零,两个方向的差异,总体平均值为-0.8-0.8分.
因此,我们没有发现任何证据表明接触原始文本会增强力度。
就发现的假设而言,物品数量太少(每个任务10至18个),无法支持同类的可靠比较。

blocks.en: 5.3 Hypothesis-Only Shortcuts
blocks.zh: 5.3 假设 -- -- 只有快捷键

Positive values indicate less degradation for easy items. GPT-4o and DeepSeek-V4-Pro were evaluated on a sample of 2,000 items.

blocks.en:
Following Gururangan et al. (2018) , we train a hypothesis-only classifier (logistic regression on word unigrams and bigrams) on the training hypotheses of each dataset, and split the evaluation items into correctly predicted items (easy items) and the remaining items (hard items).
The classifier reaches 54.3% on MNLI, in line with Gururangan et al. (2018) , 42.0–43.1% on the ANLI rounds and 47.7% (below chance) on RTE.
If hypothesis cues are the factor maintaining accuracy for perturbed inputs, then easy items should have a lower drop than hard items, and such a difference should depend on whether the perturbation preserves those cues.
blocks.zh:
继Gurururangan等人(2018年)之后,我们就每个数据集的培训假设,培训一个只假设的分类器(unigrams和bigrams词上的法律回归),并将评价项目分为正确的预测项目(容易项目)和其余项目(硬项目)。
分类器在MNLI上达到54.3%,与Gurururangan等人(2018年)保持一致,在ANLI回合中达到42.0-43.1 %,在RTE上达到47.7%(低于概率)。
如果假设提示是保持扰动输入精度的因素,那么容易的项目应该有比硬项目更低的下降,这种差异应该取决于扰动是否保留了这些提示.

blocks.en:
Both predictions hold on MNLI for the three models with the most robust MNLI performance, Qwen3.8-27B and the two OLMo 3 models (Figure 2 ).
For OLMo 3 32B and 7B, easy items lose 7.5 and 4.0 points less than hard items when nouns are removed, 10.2 and 6.7 points less when words are shuffled, and 18.1 and 17.0 points less when the premise is removed altogether.
Qwen3.8-27B shows the same pattern with a smaller gap without nouns (2.0 points), and all of these intervals exclude zero.
The one perturbation that reverses the pattern is keep-NOUN+VERB : here easy items lose more , by 2.3–4.4 points for the three models.
This is also the only perturbation that removes function words, including negation words such as not , no and never , which are the strongest hypothesis-only cues in MNLI ( Gururangan et al., 2018 ) .
Easy items are also easier on clean input (93.6% vs. 87.4% for OLMo 3 32B), which leaves them more room to drop, so the comparison is, if anything, conservative.
blocks.zh:
两种预测都坚持了MNLI对MNLI性能最强的三种模型,Qune3.8-27B和两种OLMo 3模型(图2.
对于OLMo 3 32B和7B,易取项目在去掉名词时会比硬项损失7.5分和4.0分,去掉单词时会减少10.2分和6.7分,去掉前提时会减少18.1分和17.0分.
Quen3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). 页:1 显示相同图案,没有名词的空白较小(2.0分),所有这些间隔都排除了零。
扭转模式的一种扰动是保持-NOUN+VERB : 这里容易的项目损失更多,对三种模式来说是2.3–4.4分.
这也是唯一一个删除函数词的扰动, 包括否定等词,
简单项目在清洁输入上也比较容易(OLMo 3 32B的93.6%对87.4%),这给它们留下了更大的下降空间,所以比较,如果有的话,是保守的.

blocks.en:
However, this pattern does not appear in all models.
For Muse Glimmer 30B, this phenomenon occurs only under the drop-VERB and shuffle-n1 conditions. For GPT-4o, easy items show greater score loss (9.2 points) when nouns are absent, while no reliable difference appears under other conditions.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro shows a reliable difference (7.9 points) only when the premise is removed, and no difference appears in Mistral Large 3, which is scored based on raw answers.
The same applies to Grok 4.7 (all four MNLI intervals include 0). In other words, this effect is most clearly evident in open-weight models that we score ourselves, but not in hosted models.
In ANLI, results are mixed across perturbations, but when the premise is removed, most models show less R2 and R3 score loss for easier items (a difference of 8–14 points). This suggests that the weak cues remaining in ANLI are used in the same way.
blocks.zh:
然而,并非所有模型都出现这种模式。
对于Muse Glimmer 30B来说,这种现象只在滴入-VERB和shuffle-n1条件下出现. 对于GPT-4o来说,当名词缺席时,容易的项目表现出更大的分数损失(9.2分),而在其他条件下则没有出现可靠的差异.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro只有在去除前提时才会显示可靠的差分(7.9分),而米斯特拉尔大3中则没有出现差分,根据原始答案得分.
Grok 4.7(所有四个MNLI间隔包括0个)也是如此. 换句话说,这种效果在我们自己得分的开放量级模型中最为明显,但在主机模型中并非如此.
在ANLI中,结果在各种扰动之间混杂,但去掉前提后,大多数型号对更简单的项目显示的R2和R3得分损失较少(相差8–14分). 这表明ANLI中残留的弱提示同样使用.

blocks.en: 5.4 Fresh Items
blocks.zh: 5.4 新鲜物品

blocks.en: Table 2: New items written in MNLI style or without cues (168 and 148 items): clean accuracy (%, centred where answer scores exist), retention rate of performance above chance ( R R , %) under drop-NOUN and keep-NOUN+VERB conditions, and difference between easy and hard items in drop-NOUN drop for MNLI-style items (points, with ∗ for 95% confidence intervals excluding 0). Symbols are the same as Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 表 2: 以 MNLI 样式或无提示(168和148项)写出的新项目:干净的准确度(%,在有答题分数的地方居于中心),在 NOUN 和 NOUN+VERB 条件下的超概率性能保留率(R,%),以及 MNLI 样式项目在 NOUN 的下放中容易和难得项目的区别(分数,其中 * 95%的置信间隔不包括 0). 符号与表1同.

blocks.en:
The new items enable the most direct test: no model has seen them, but the MNLI-style items have the same type of cues as MNLI.
If memorisation causes the robustness on MNLI, it should disappear on these items; if shortcuts cause it, it should remain on MNLI-style items and shrink on cue-free ones.
blocks.zh:
新项目可以进行最直接的测试:没有模型看到它们,但MNLI风格的项目具有和MNLI相同的提示类型.
如果记忆在MNLI上造成坚固性,它应该在这些项目上消失;如果捷径造成它,它应该留在MNLI式的物品上并收缩在无提示的物品上.

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows the second pattern in all models.
In the absence of nouns, all eight LLMs maintain higher performance in MNLI-style items (50–75% vs. 37–57%) than in cue-free items, which is nearly the same level as performance in MNLI itself.
When only nouns and verbs remain, the order is reversed in all models tested with this perturbation (42–59% vs. 62–74%), as on MNLI.
Within MNLI-style items, items correctly labelled by the MNLI hypothesis-only classifier show 11–28 points less loss than the remaining items when nouns are absent, and for 7 of the 8 models the 95% interval excludes zero.
The same effect is observed here in the reasoning model and in hosted models, even though such effects were not present on MNLI.
The new items are easier than MNLI (93–100% clean accuracy), and since most were labelled by a single annotator, absolute figures should be interpreted with caution. However, the difference between the two styles is consistently observed across all models.
blocks.zh:
表2显示了所有模型中的第二种模式。
在没有名词的情况下,所有8个LLMs在MNLI风格的物品(50–75%对37–57%)中保持了更高的性能,这几乎与MNLI本身的性能相同.
当仅保留名词和动词时,所有通过这种扰动测试的模型(42–59%对62–74 %),如MNLI上,顺序被颠倒.
在 MNLI 类项目中,由 MNLI 假说唯一的分类器正确标记的项目显示,当名词缺失时,损失比其余项目少出11–28分,对于8个模型中的7个模型,95%的间隔排除了零.
在推理模型和主机模型中也观察到同样的效果,尽管这种效果在MNLI上并不存在.
新的项目比MNLI(93-100%的准确性)容易,由于大多数项目都是由一个注释者标注的,因此绝对数字的解释应谨慎。 然而,两种风格之间的差异在所有模型中都得到一致的观察到.

blocks.en: 5.5 A Benchmark Without Hypothesis Cues
blocks.zh: 5.5 无假设基准

blocks.en:
Robustness to perturbations does not necessarily come from shortcuts: models may also answer from what they already know.
To see robustness without hypothesis cues, we perturbed the evidence passages of the 1,519 yes/no questions in BioASQ ( Tsatsaronis et al., 2015 ) and kept the questions, which act as hypotheses, intact.
A classifier using only the questions did not outperform the majority baseline on the three most recent test sets, and we found no sign of memorisation (Appendix H ).
Nevertheless, the models retained 64–89% of their above-chance AUC without any evidence, compared to 26–51% on MNLI using only hypotheses (Table 10 in Appendix H ).
Unlike MNLI, keeping only nouns and verbs is almost no more costly than removing nouns (83–96% retention compared to 38–47% retention in MNLI).
BioASQ is therefore robust for other reasons, most likely biomedical knowledge, and the reversal under keep-NOUN+VERB in MNLI appears to be specific to data whose cues lie in function words.
blocks.zh:
对扰动的强力并不一定来自捷径:模型也可能从他们已经知道的东西中解答.
在BioASQ(Tsatsaronis等,2015年)中, 我们干扰了1,519个“是/否”问题的证据段落,
仅使用这些问题的分类器没有超过最近三套测试的多数基线,我们没有发现任何记忆的迹象(附录H.
然而,这些模型在没有任何证据的情况下保留了64-89%的上述AUC,而仅使用假设(附录H表10)的MNLI为26-51%。
与MNLI不同,只保留名词和动词几乎不会比去掉名词成本更高(保留83-96%,而MNLI保留38-47%).
因此,BioASQ由于其他原因非常强大,最有可能是生物医学知识,而MNLI中保存-NOUN+VERB的倒置似乎针对的是其提示位于函数词的数据。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Taken together, the results point away from memorisation and towards shortcuts as the reason why familiar NLI benchmarks survive perturbation.
Four observations support this reading.
First, the contrast between MNLI and ANLI is shared by every system that answers directly, including RoBERTa fine-tuned on MNLI, whose robustness comes from what it learned from MNLI’s training data rather than from having seen the evaluation items.
Second, none of the contamination indicators is related to robustness: items whose text is found in OLMo’s pre-training data lose as much as items whose text is not.
Third, for the open LLMs most robust on MNLI, items that can be solved from the hypothesis alone are more robust, and lose this advantage exactly when the perturbation removes the function words that carry the cues.
Fourth, and most directly, every LLM shows the same signature on fresh items that it cannot have seen, as long as they are written in MNLI’s style.
blocks.zh:
总而言之,结果表明,人们所熟悉的NLI基准之所以能够幸存,是因为人们不再记忆并走上捷径。
4个观察支持这一解读.
首先,MNLI和ANLI之间的对比被每个直接回答的系统所分享,其中包括对MNLI进行微调的RoBERTa,其强性来自MNLI从培训数据中汲取的教训,而不是已经看到评价项目.
第二,没有任何污染指标与坚固性有关:在OLMo培训前数据中找到文本的项目损失与文本中不存在的项目一样多。
第三,对于MNLI上最坚固的开放式LLMS,单从假说中可以解出的项目会更坚固,而当扰动移除了带出提示的函数单词时,恰恰会失去这一优势.
第四,最直接的是,每个LLM在新项目上都显示它无法看到的相同签名,只要这些签名是用MNLI的风格所写的.

blocks.en:
The hosted models and the reasoning model show no hypothesis-only effect on MNLI itself, although they do on the fresh MNLI-style items, so they can exploit the same cues.
Why the effect is absent on MNLI remains open: their training data are unknown, so memorisation of MNLI cannot be ruled out for them, and they may rely on cues our classifier does not capture, such as lexical overlap ( McCoy et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh:
主机模型和推理模型对MNLI本身没有只显示假说的效果,尽管它们对新鲜的MNLI风格物品有作用,因此可以利用同一种提示.
为什么对MNLI没有效果仍然开放:他们的训练数据未知,因此无法排除对MNLI的记忆,他们可能依赖于我们的分类器无法捕捉到的提示,如词汇重叠(McCoy等,2019年).

blocks.en:
On MNLI, a large part of the benchmark can be solved from surface properties of the hypothesis that the perturbations leave intact; ANLI was built to remove such properties, and on ANLI all systems fall close to chance once the nouns are gone.
In each case the perturbation experiments measure the benchmark as much as the model.
blocks.zh:
在MNLI上,从扰动离开完好无损的假设的地表属性中可以解出一大部分基准;ANLI是用来去除这些属性的;在ANLI上,当名词消失后,所有系统都接近机会.
在每一种情况下,扰动实验都与模型一样衡量基准。

blocks.en:
Do models, then, need to understand language to do well on these benchmarks?
Our results suggest that the answer depends on the benchmark more than on the model.
On MNLI, understanding the sentence pair is sufficient for a high score but not necessary: much of the benchmark can still be solved once the words a human reader would need are gone ( Talman et al., 2021 ) .
In this sense MNLI measures, in part, how its annotators wrote hypotheses rather than whether one sentence follows from another.
This does not mean that the models fail to understand the pairs.
On the cue-free fresh items every LLM reaches 93–98% on clean input, so the models can draw the inference when no cue is available; a benchmark on which a cue-based and an inference-based solution score alike simply cannot tell the two apart.
BioASQ adds a further distinction, between understanding the evidence and already knowing the answer.
We would therefore argue that a benchmark score neither confirms nor refutes understanding, which is better seen as a matter of degree, and that perturbation experiments are most useful for finding out what a given benchmark can and cannot distinguish.
blocks.zh:
那么模型是否需要理解语言才能在这些基准上做得好?
我们的结果表明,答案更多地取决于基准而不是模型。
在MNLI上,理解句子配对足以达到高分,但并不必要:在人类读者需要的词消失后,许多基准仍然可以解决(Talman等,2021年).
从这个意义上说,MNLI的计量部分是它的注释者如何写出假说,而不是一个句子是否从另一个句子上走来.
这并不意味着模型不能理解对子.
在无提示的新鲜项目上,每个LLM在干净的输入上达到93-98%,因此当没有提示时,模型可以得出推论;一个基于提示和基于推论的解决方案同样得分的基准根本无法区分两者。
BioASQ进一步区分了理解证据和已经知道答案之间的区别.
因此,我们主张,基准得分既不确认也不否定理解,而理解最好被看作是程度问题,而扰动实验对找出一个特定基准能够和无法区分的东西最有用。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper we have revisited the effect of input perturbations on NLI and other language understanding tasks with LLMs and fine-tuned encoders.
Every system that answers directly keeps 36–72% of its above-chance MNLI performance without nouns but only 14–29% on ANLI, whatever its size.
Contamination indicators show no link between exposure and robustness, whereas items solvable from the hypothesis are more robust.
On 368 fresh items that no model can have seen, all eight LLMs keep more of their performance on items written in MNLI’s style than on cue-free items, and lose this advantage when function words are removed.
We therefore argue that robustness to perturbation on familiar NLI benchmarks reflects shortcuts in the datasets rather than memorisation.
We recommend that robustness results on NLI benchmarks be reported together with a hypothesis-only analysis and, where possible, on items written after the models’ training data were collected.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们重新审视了输入扰动对NLI的影响,以及与LLMs和微调编码器的其他语言理解任务.
每一个直接回答的系统都保留了36–72%的以上 MNLI 性能,没有名词,但不管大小,在 ANLI 上只保留了14–29 %.
污染指标显示,接触与强性之间没有联系,而从假设中可溶解的物品则更为坚固。
在368个没有模型能看见的新项目上,所有8个LLMs都保留了在以 MNLI 风格所写项目上的性能,而不是在无提示项目上,在去除函数词后失去这一优势.
因此,我们认为,对熟悉的NLI基准的强力性反映了数据集中的捷径,而不是记忆。
我们建议,应报告关于NLI基准的稳健性结果,同时只进行假设分析,并在可能的情况下,报告在收集模型培训数据后编写的项目。

blocks.en: Open questions remain: a larger, multiply annotated fresh set would sharpen the comparison; other cues, such as lexical overlap ( McCoy et al., 2019 ) , may explain why the hosted models show no hypothesis-only effect on MNLI; and it remains to be seen whether reasoning models in general escape the MNLI–ANLI contrast.
blocks.zh: 开放式问题依然存在:一个更大的、倍倍的注解新组合会使比较更加清晰;其他提示,例如词汇重叠(McCoy等,2019年),可能解释主机模型为何对MNLI没有只显示假设效应;一般推理模型是否逃脱了MNLI-ANLI对比,尚有待观察.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our contamination checks are partial.
The n n -gram counts cover the OLMo 2 pre-training mix rather than that of OLMo 3, sample only two 13-grams per field, and detect only verbatim overlap; paraphrased or reformatted copies of a benchmark, for example in code repositories, would be missed.
For the other models the training data are not available, and the indirect indicators we use are known to be noisy.
The absence of a link between exposure and robustness is therefore evidence against memorisation as the main explanation, not proof that the models have not seen the benchmarks; the fresh items address this for the comparison that matters most, but not for MNLI itself.
blocks.zh:
我们的污染检查是局部的。
n-克计数涵盖OLMo 2的预训组合,而不是OLMo 3的预训组合,每个字段只抽取出2个13克的样本,只检测出逐字记录重叠;将忽略一个基准的被译出或重编的拷贝,例如在代码寄存器中。
对于其他模型来说,没有培训数据,我们使用的间接指标众所周知很吵。
因此,在接触和强性之间缺乏联系,是不能将记忆作为主要解释的证据,而不是模型没有看到基准的证据;新的项目是为了进行比较而解决这一点的,而MNLI本身则不是。

blocks.en:
The shortcut split depends on one simple classifier; items it labels incorrectly may still contain cues that a stronger classifier would find, so the split underestimates the number of shortcut-solvable items, and a stronger hypothesis-only model, such as a fine-tuned encoder, would give a sharper one.
The hosted models are analysed on the 2,000-item MNLI sample, which gives the comparison less power than for the open models.
blocks.zh:
快捷键拆分取决于一个简单的分类器;它标签错误的项目可能仍然包含一个更强的分类器会找到的提示,因此该拆分低估了快捷键可解项的数量,而更强的仅假说模型,如微调编码器,会给出更锐利的提示.
对主机模型进行了2000个项目MNLI样本的分析,这使得对比的功率低于开放式模型.

blocks.en:
The LLMs are scored with a single prompt template per task and, for the open models, by answer log-probability.
Other templates or free-form generation could give different absolute numbers, although the comparisons we draw are within a model and template; a second template would show how far the absolute numbers depend on it.
The hosted models are evaluated on the core set of perturbations and, for MNLI and QQP, on a 2,000-item sample, and their providers may change the models behind an endpoint over time.
All experiments are on English data.
The BioASQ comparison covers only the yes/no questions and six models, and is scored by AUC rather than centred accuracy.
The fresh items were written by two LLMs and validated mostly by a single volunteer annotator each, none a native English speaker; their hypotheses differ between the two styles in more than cues (for example, cue-free hypotheses are longer), and a larger set with several labels per item would make the comparison more reliable.
blocks.zh:
LLMs每个任务都使用单一的即时模板来打分,对于开放型号,则通过答案日志概率来打分.
其他模板或自由形式生成可以给出不同的绝对数字,尽管我们绘制的比较是在模型和模板内;第二个模板将显示绝对数字依赖它的程度.
对主机模型进行核心扰动集评价,对MNLI和QQP则进行2000个项目样本评价,其提供者可能会随着时间的推移改变端点后面的模型.
所有实验都在英语数据上.
BioASQ比较只涵盖"是"/"否"问题和6个型号,由AUC评分,而不是取取取中心精度.
新鲜物品由两个LLM写出,并且大多由一个志愿的每个注释者验证,没有一个本地的英语演讲者;他们的假设在多出提示(例如,免提示假设更长)的两种风格之间有所不同,一个较大的组合,每个项目有多个标签,将使比较更加可靠.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
We use GLUE ( Wang et al., 2018 ) under the licences of its component datasets, ANLI under CC BY-NC 4.0, and Wikipedia text under CC BY-SA 4.0; open models are used under their published licences and hosted models under their providers’ terms. We report results only in aggregate.
The fresh items were labelled by unpaid volunteers who could stop at any time; their age and language background were collected only to describe the rater pool and are reported only in aggregate.
Hosted models were accessed through their providers’ standard interfaces; a small number of items (at most 0.5% per perturbation for MNLI and ANLI, 1% for RTE) were blocked by a provider’s content filter and are counted as errors.

我们使用GLUE(Wang等,2018年)在其组件数据集许可下使用,ANLI在CC BY-NC 4.0下使用,维基百科文本在CC BY-SA 4.0下使用;开放模式在其已发布的许可下使用,并根据供应商条款托管模式. 我们只报告总体结果。

blocks.en: Appendix A Reproducing the Earlier Results
blocks.zh: 附录A 转载早先的成果

blocks.en:
We reproduce the drop-NOUN experiments of Talman et al. (2022) with RoBERTa-base on five GLUE tasks and those of Talman et al. (2021) with BERT-base on MNLI.
As in the earlier work, there are three conditions: Corrupt-Test (trained on clean data, tested on perturbed data), Corrupt-Train (trained on perturbed data, tested on clean data) and Corrupt-Train-and-Test (perturbed in both).
Table 3 gives the published and the reproduced scores side by side.
On MNLI, all reproduced scores are within 0.6 points of the published ones, and the other GLUE tasks are within about 3 points, with two exceptions.
Our clean CoLA score is 5.2 points lower, and our Corrupt-Train models reach 62.9 on RTE instead of 47.3.
The published RTE figure equals the share of entailment items in the development set (131 of 277), which suggests that the original run predicted a single class; our three seeds did not.
For ANLI, we evaluate the released RoBERTa-large model of Nie et al. (2020) on the clean test sets and on the perturbed test sets released by Talman et al. (2021) ; all scores are within three points of the published ones (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们转载了Talman等人(2022年)在GLUE五项任务的RoBERTa-base和Talman等人(2021年)在MNLI上的BERT-base试验。
与先前的工作一样,有以下三个条件:腐败测试(经过清洁数据培训,经过干扰数据测试),腐败培训(经过干扰数据培训,经过清理数据测试)和腐败培训和测试(两次测试都受到干扰)。
表3列出公布的成绩和复制的成绩。

blocks.en:
All tasks share one template per task; the NLI tasks (MNLI, ANLI, fresh items) use: Premise: {premise} Hypothesis: {hypothesis} Does the premise entail the hypothesis, contradict it, or neither? Answer with one word: entailment, neutral, or contradiction. RTE asks Does the premise entail the hypothesis? with the answers yes or no ; QNLI asks whether a sentence contains the answer to a question; MRPC and QQP whether two sentences (questions) mean (ask) the same thing; SST-2 for the sentiment ( positive or negative ); CoLA whether a sentence is grammatically acceptable; STS-B for a similarity score from 0 to 5.
Base models receive the text followed by Answer: ; chat models and hosted models receive it as a user message.
In the five-shot setting, five training examples precede the item, each followed by its gold answer (as Answer: <word> for base models, as an assistant turn for chat models), drawn label-balanced with a fixed seed; for the ablated variant the same perturbation is applied to the examples.

blocks.en:
For encoders, training on ablated data recovers most of the loss ( Talman et al., 2021 ; Talman et al., 2022 ) : RoBERTa-base reaches 85.8 on clean MNLI after training without nouns, and 77.7 when tested without nouns as well (Table 3 ).
Is there an in-context analogue for LLMs?
Table 5 suggests that there is not.
Five examples help OLMo 3 32B on ANLI R1 and QNLI, raising the retained share from 23% to 31% and from 44% to 56%.
Ablated examples, however, show no consistent advantage over clean ones: the two differ by at most six points in either direction, and on MNLI not at all (72% with either kind for OLMo 3 32B, 67% for OLMo 3 7B).
The model does not adapt to the ablation shown in the examples; the gain comes from the examples themselves.

blocks.en:
Premises were taken from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0) and kept at most two per article; the infini-gram check dropped any premise with a 13-gram found in the OLMo 2 pre-training mix.
Generators alternated over premises, so each wrote half of the items in both styles.
Raters (14 volunteers, none a native English speaker, median 21 seconds per item) saw premise and hypothesis only, labelled each pair as entailment, neutral or contradiction from the premise alone, and could flag ambiguous, ungrammatical or knowledge-dependent pairs.
Most items received one label; on the 32 items with several, Krippendorff’s α \alpha is 0.82, and the labels agree with the intended label on 85.6% of the labelled generated items.
Revision pairs that differ only in case, punctuation or word order (28) were dropped.
On the kept items, the MNLI hypothesis-only classifier reaches 65.5% on MNLI-style and 41.9% on cue-free items (54.3% on MNLI itself), and 39% of MNLI-style contradictions contain a negation word, against none of the cue-free ones.
The items remain private until publication so that they stay unseen.

Llama-3.3-70B, evaluated on BioASQ only, retains 95% of its above-chance AUC under drop-NOUN .

Almost all of the loss falls on gold- no items, which the models increasingly answer with yes as the evidence degrades; gold- yes accuracy stays at 97–100% under every perturbation.

AUC, which does not depend on a decision threshold, corrects for this default.

blocks.en:
By the developers’ stated training cut-offs, the 12b–14b questions postdate the training data of GPT-4o and Llama-3.3-70B, 13b and 14b that of OLMo 3, and, by a third-party report, 14b that of DeepSeek-V4-Pro; Qwen3.8 has no published cut-off.
On factoid questions, the share of performance kept without the evidence on these newer questions overlaps that on the training set for every model; yes/no questions are too few per year for this comparison.
For the 1,668 factoid questions, we compared items most of whose snippets contain a 13-gram found in the OLMo 2 pre-training mix with the rest, stratified by the number of snippets; the difference in the drop without evidence is within its interval for every model in the pooled data.

关于事实问题,在这些较新问题上没有证据的绩效份额与每个模式的培训内容重叠;对/没有问题,每年比较太少。
对于1,668个事实问题,我们比较了大部分片段包含在OLMo 2预训组合中发现的13克与其余部分的项目,按片段数量进行分级;没有证据的投放的区别是在集合数据中每个模型的间隔内.
